senses.gloss:
श्रौत श्रौत, i. e. श्रुत + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating to the ear, hearing.
 2. Relating to sacred learning, on the Vedas, Padmap. 8, 11 (see श्रोतस्).
 3. Prescribed by the Vedas, Śāk. 61, 12.
 II. n. Any observance ordained by the Vedas.
श्रौषट् श्रौषट्, anomal. old conjunct. of the aor. of श्रु (cf. वषट्), indecl. An exclamation used in making an offering to the Manes or gods.
